annotations.title: Get a link to upload a file

description: An upload link for pictures or videos (PNG, JPEG, WebP or MP4), for files you made or hold where sending them in media_upload is not practical, such as pictures drawn in your own sandbox or photos on the user’s phone. Send bytes to url with PUT and its Content-Type, no sign-in needed; the answer is its media id. Where you cannot reach the web, give the user the link: they open it, pick the file(s) and press Upload; then media_list shows them newest first. By default a link takes 1 file and ends after an hour; pass multiple: true (or maxFiles 2 to 20) for a 24-hour multi-file dropzone. Nothing is posted. Make a picture a JPEG: every network that takes pictures accepts JPEG, while Instagram refuses PNG and WebP (capabilities lists each network’s mediaTypes).

alt.description: What the picture shows, for people who cannot see it. Kept with the file.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

maxFiles.description: Maximum files this link accepts (1 to 20). Values from 2 to 20 stay open for 24 hours; 1 ends after 1 hour.

multiple.description: true opens a 24-hour multi-file dropzone for up to 20 photos or videos instead of a one-file 1-hour link.

name.description: A file name for the user’s own list. Taken from the file when left out.
